hunks.baseline: Seong Jinho, that miserable excuse for a human being.
hunks.sol: Seong Jinho, my mortal enemy.

hunks.baseline: Grumbling, I pulled the blanket up to my neck. The woman lying beside me let out a small whine.
hunks.sol: Grumbling, I pulled the blanket up to my neck. The woman lying beside me let out a soft whine.

hunks.baseline: *A woman? Which woman?*
hunks.sol: *A woman? What woman?*

hunks.baseline: I woke in an instant and shot upright like a soldier hearing the wake-up signal. Then I slowly turned my head.
hunks.sol: I woke in an instant and shot upright like a private hearing reveille. Then I slowly turned my head.

hunks.baseline: Good heavens. I was stunned twice over. First, because I couldn’t make sense of the situation. Second, because the woman lying beside me was unbelievably beautiful.
hunks.sol: Good lord. I was stunned twice over. First, because I couldn’t make sense of the situation. Second, because the woman lying beside me was unbelievably beautiful.

hunks.baseline: She kept muttering words I couldn’t understand and burrowed deeper beneath the blanket. Even in my dazed state, she was beautiful enough to make my heart skip.
hunks.sol: She kept muttering words I couldn’t understand as she burrowed deeper beneath the blanket. Even in my dazed state, she was beautiful enough to make my heart skip a beat.

hunks.baseline: The situation was becoming more and more baffling. After staring blankly around the room, I grabbed the woman by the shoulder and shook her.
hunks.sol: The situation grew more baffling by the second. After staring blankly around the room, I grabbed the woman by the shoulder and shook her.

hunks.baseline: I scratched vigorously at the back of my head in frustration. The next moment, I sprang up like a released spring.
hunks.sol: I scratched vigorously at the back of my head in frustration. The next moment, I sprang up like a coiled spring.

hunks.baseline: I stole glances at Wolhwa’s face as I drank the water, then nearly jumped out of my skin.
hunks.sol: I stole glances at Wolhwa’s face as I drank the water, then started in surprise.

hunks.baseline: “Just because. I wanted to see you?”
hunks.sol: “Just because. I wanted to look at you?”

hunks.baseline: *The game’s progression is pretty innovative.*
hunks.sol: *The way this game unfolds is pretty innovative.*

hunks.baseline: “Uh… Check quest?”
hunks.sol: *Uh… Check quest?*

hunks.baseline: Even as I said it, I wasn’t sure whether that was the right command. But with the familiar sound effect, a quest window appeared at once.
hunks.sol: Even as I thought it, I wasn’t sure whether that was the right command. But with the familiar sound effect, a quest window appeared at once.

hunks.baseline: *Got her.*
hunks.sol: *She took the bait.*

hunks.baseline: “The youngest son of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, who came of age at twenty this year. Surely I don’t need to tell you his name as well?”
hunks.sol: “The youngest son of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, who turned twenty this year. Surely I don’t need to tell you his name as well?”

hunks.baseline: “They have a good reputation among the public. From time to time, they wipe out bands of mounted bandits, and when droughts come, they distribute relief grain before even the magistrate’s office does.”
hunks.sol: “They have a good reputation among the people. From time to time, they wipe out bands of mounted bandits, and when droughts come, they distribute relief grain before even the magistrate’s office does.”

hunks.baseline: “More than anything, they’re a prestigious family representing Shanxi. You could call them a deeply rooted old tree.”
hunks.sol: “More than anything, they’re a prestigious family representing Shanxi Province. You could call them an old tree with deep roots.”

hunks.baseline: “Externally, there’s the conflict with the Mount Heng Sword Sect, which is constantly eyeing the position of Shanxi’s hegemon. Internally…”
hunks.sol: “Externally, there’s the conflict with the Mount Heng Sword Sect, which is constantly eyeing the position of Alliance Leader in Shanxi Province. Internally…”

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t decide whether to laugh or cry. Then I saw Wolhwa snickering and let out a hollow laugh myself.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t decide whether to laugh or cry. Then I saw Wolhwa quietly chuckling and let out a hollow laugh myself.

hunks.baseline: *Well, better to look on the bright side. So what if I’m the shame of the family? It’s only a game, anyway.*
hunks.sol: *Fine. No point getting worked up. So what if I’m the shame of the family? It’s only a game, anyway.*

hunks.baseline: We were in Honghwaru, located in the heart of Taiyuan. Wolhwa was a fairly high-ranking courtesan, and I had spent the night with her… Ahem.
hunks.sol: We were in Honghwaru, located in the heart of Taiyuan. Wolhwa was a fairly high-ranking courtesan, and she and I had spent the night… Ahem.

hunks.baseline: Despite all the various things we discussed, no System notification appeared. Eventually, I ran out of questions to ask.
hunks.sol: Despite everything we discussed, no System notification appeared. Eventually, I ran out of questions to ask.

hunks.baseline: The graphics and artificial intelligence were all great, but being stuck at the tutorial had completely drained the fun out of it. If there was one thing I’d learned, it was that the capsule I’d found yesterday was a much better piece of equipment than it looked.
hunks.sol: The graphics and artificial intelligence were all great, but getting stuck on the tutorial had completely drained the fun out of it. If there was one thing I’d learned, it was that the capsule I’d found yesterday was a much better piece of equipment than it looked.

hunks.sol: I said goodbye to Wolhwa with one last glance and shouted:

hunks.sol: An error? Or had the piece-of-junk capsule finally started lagging?

hunks.baseline: There was no doubt about it. Error or lag, the damn old capsule had finally caused trouble. I tried ten more times after that, but every attempt failed.
hunks.sol: There was no doubt about it. Error or lag, the damn junk capsule had finally caused trouble. I tried ten more times after that, but every attempt failed.
